 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:20175  CRL.P No. 4863 of 2023  THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.438 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF HIS ARREST IN CR.NO.80/2023 REGISTERED BY THE SECOND RESPONDENT CHHAPAR POLICE FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCE P/U/S.406, 498-A, 323, 506 OF IPC DURING THE PENDENCY OF CRL.MISC.NO.5112/2023 ON THE FILE OF THE XLV ADDITIONAL CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE (CCH-46)
OR TILL SUCH TIME THE PETITIONER APPROACHES JURISDICTIONAL COURT AT RAJASTHAN SEEKING BAIL.

entities.text: JURISDICTIONAL COURT AT RAJASTHAN SEEKING BAIL
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Petitioner is seeking transit bail so as to enable him to approach the jurisdictional Court at Rajasthan and file necessary petition seeking anticipatory bail.

2. It appears that Crime No.80/2023 has been registered against the petitioner by Chapar Police Station, Churu District, Rajasthan for offences punishable under Sections 406, 498A, 323 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC' for short).
3.

entities.text: Chapar Police Station, Churu District, Rajasthan
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioner has already approached the learned Sessions Judge seeking transit anticipatory bail, which is pending consideration.
It is submitted that notice is issued to NC: 2023:KHC:20175 respondent Nos.1 and 2 and the prayer for grant of interim anticipatory bail has been rejected.
4. When the petitioner has already filed the petition which is pending consideration before the learned Sessions Judge, this petition seeking similar prayer is not maintainable.
5. Learned Sessions Judge is directed to dispose of the petition as expeditiously as possible.

Sd/-
